overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、回归分析为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（6 篇）、arXiv（2 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: A Bioeconomic Prey-Predator Model with a Water-Pollution Modification Parameter and Stability Analysis
papers.venue: African Multidisciplinary Journal of Sciences and Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Managing interacting fish populations requires consideration of ecological processes and human pressures across reserve and unreserved zones. This study developed and analyzed a bioeconomic predator–prey model for three interacting fish populations: cichlids, tilapia, and Nile perch. The model incorporated water pollution, harvesting, migration, and predation across both zones. Equilibrium points and their existence conditions were derived, and the local stability of selected equilibria was assessed using Jacobian linearization and the Routh–Hurwitz criterion. Numerical simulations examined the effects of pollution control, predation control, and a combined strategy integrating water-quality improvement and migration. The results indicated that stronger pollution control enhanced fish population persistence in the unreserved zone. The combined strategy produced greater improvements than individual interventions, while predator–prey interactions remained integral to the modeled ecosystem. These findings highlight the potential benefits of coordinating water-quality improvement and migration management to support fish population persistence. The model provides an analytical framework for evaluating management strategies that account for pollution, harvesting, and ecological interactions in aquatic systems with reserve and unreserved zones.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】管理相互作用的鱼类种群需要考虑保护区与非保护区内的生态过程及人类活动的影响。本研究建立并分析了一个针对三种相互作用的鱼类种群（丽鱼、罗非鱼和尼罗河鲈鱼）的生物经济捕食者-猎物模型。该模型涵盖了水污染、捕捞、迁徙及捕食行为在两个区域内的影响。通过推导得出平衡点及其存在条件，并利用雅可比线性化方法和劳斯-赫维茨准则评估了选定平衡点的局部稳定性。数值模拟研究了污染控制、捕食控制以及结合水质改善与迁徙策略的综合效果。结果表明，加强污染控制有助于提高非保护区内的鱼类种群持续性；综合策略比单一干预措施更具成效，同时捕食者-猎物之间的相互作用在所建立的生态系统中仍起着关键作用。这些发现强调了协调水质改善与迁徙管理以支持鱼类种群持续存在的潜在益处。该模型为评估考虑污染、捕捞及生态相互作用的管理策略提供了分析框架，适用于包含保护区和非保护区的水生系统。。研究方法：数值模拟、均衡模型。

papers.title: COVID-19 diagnosis using a decision tree algorithm
papers.abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) is a respiratory infection for which chest X-ray (CXR) imaging can provide an accessible screening modality. This study investigates an interpretable computer-aided screening pipeline for distinguishing COVID-19-positive from normal CXR images. Methods: The pipeline combines Otsu-based lung segmentation, morphological refinement, seven Hu invariant shape moments, training-fold z-score normalization, and a class-weighted Decision Tree. A cohort of 2,600 CXR images (1,000 COVID-19-positive and 1,600 normal) was evaluated using stratified five-fold cross-validation. The retained experimental record reports 98.6% accuracy, 97.8% precision, 98.6% recall (sensitivity), and 98.2% F1-score. The pooled confusion matrix shows TP=986, FN=14, FP=22, and TN=1578, corresponding to 98.6% accuracy and 97.8% precision. ROC/AUC analysis yielded AUC = 0.987 ± 0.004 under the image-level evaluation protocol. Conclusion: The findings indicate that a low-dimensional, shape-based descriptor combined with an interpretable Decision Tree can discriminate COVID-19-positive from normal CXR images under the present internal image-level protocol. Because the cohort was not partitioned at the patient or source level and no independent external cohort was retained in the study record, the results are considered preliminary proof-of-concept evidence rather than clinically validated diagnostic performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）是一种呼吸道感染疾病，胸部X光（CXR）成像可作为一种便捷的筛查手段。本研究开发了一种可解释的计算机辅助筛查流程，用于区分COVID-19阳性病例与正常胸部X光图像。研究方法包括：基于Otsu算法的肺部分割技术、形态学处理、七种Hu不变形状矩、训练数据集的z分数标准化处理，以及基于类别权重的决策树模型。研究使用了包含2,600张胸部X光图像（1,000张COVID-19阳性图像和1,600张正常图像）的队列数据，通过分层五折交叉验证进行评估。实验结果显示：该系统的准确率为98.6%，精确率为97.8%，召回率为98.6%，F1分数为98.2%。综合混淆矩阵数据显示，真正例（TP）为986例，假正例（FP）为22例，假负例（FN）为14例，真正例（TN）为1,578例，相应准确率为98.6%，精确率为97.8%。在图像级评估协议下，ROC/AUC分析得出的AUC值为0.987 ± 0.004。研究结论表明：在当前的内部图像级评估框架下，一种低维的基于形状的特征描述方法结合可解释的决策树模型能够有效区分COVID-19阳性病例与正常胸部X光图像。...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: The Logic of Factor Portfolios: Boolean Rules, Interactions, and Trading Costs
papers.abstract: Investors turn signals into holdings through decision rules: buy the top decile, hold stocks with high momentum and low volatility, exclude stocks that fail a screen. Many such rules are Boolean functions of threshold statements about signal ranks, and writing them this way shows both what a rule holds and how often it trades. A Walsh decomposition splits the return of any rule into exposures to individual signals and to interactions among signals; an intersection and a union of the same two screens, for example, have opposite interaction exposures. The same coefficients, together with the persistence of the underlying statements, determine turnover. Interactions are less persistent than their components, so rules that load on higher-order interactions trade more, and thresholds discard information, so at equal risk threshold implementations of interactions trade more than smooth ones. In U.S. stocks from 1973 to 2024, these predictions hold closely: predicted and realized persistence have correlations of at least 0.999, predicted turnover matches realized turnover with a slope of 1.02, and the same interactions are more persistent as products of ranks than as threshold rules. Trading costs rise with order, and because premia fall with order, 58% of single-signal portfolios have absolute premia above their quoted-spread costs over 1995-2024, against 24% of two-signal and 6% of three-signal interaction portfolios. Out of sample, interaction portfolios raise the Sharpe ratio of single-signal tangency portfolios, and over 1995-2024 they reject a six-factor model that conventional sorts on the same signals do not reject.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】投资者通过特定的决策规则将市场信号转化为实际投资行为：买入表现最佳的股票（即排名前十的股票），持有具有高动量和低波动性的股票，同时剔除不符合筛选条件的股票。许多此类决策规则本质上是对股票信号排名信息的布尔函数表达式；以这种形式表述规则不仅能够清晰地展示其投资逻辑，还能反映其交易频率。Walsh分解技术可用于分析这些规则对各个股票信号及其相互作用的影响——例如，两个相同筛选条件的组合在信号相互作用方面的影响可能是相反的。相同的系数以及基础判断语句的持久性共同决定了投资组合的换手率。由于信号之间的相互作用往往不如单个信号本身持久，因此那些侧重于高阶信号相互作用的规则交易频率更高；而设定严格阈值的做法会忽略部分信息，因此在风险相同的情况下，基于阈值制定的交易策略比基于平滑信号处理的策略交易更频繁。在1973年至2024年间美国股市的实证研究中，这些预测结果与实际情况高度吻合：预测的信号持久性与实际观测结果之间的相关性至少达到0.999，预测的换手率与实际换手率之间的吻合度很高（斜率为1.02），且相同信号之间的相互作用比单纯的阈值判断规则更具持久性。交易成本会随着交易规模的增加而上升，...。研究方法：因子模型。

papers.title: Knowing When to Intervene: Causal Evaluation of AI Agents
papers.abstract: Current evaluations of agentic AI systems primarily rely on benchmarks. However, the static nature of benchmarks makes them uninformative about the value of auditing interventions at deployment time. For reliable deployment, we often need to determine within an agent's trajectory whether or not to intervene, e.g., by verifying the agent's current output or steering it toward different behavior, using either human review or more costly models or time-consuming agentic supervision. The value of such interventions is fundamentally a causal inference question, asking whether the causal effect of such an intervention is beneficial for the final outcome. Estimating this causal effect is particularly challenging due to the dynamic nature of the problem: the impact of an intervention depends on the current context and environment, as well as the agent's future behavior. We develop the first methodologically grounded framework for evaluating the causal effects of randomized interventions within agent trajectories. By leveraging a relatively small dataset of agent trajectories collected under randomized interventions such as verification or screening, we can estimate the dynamic causal effect of a rich class of (contextual) intervention policies. The structural parameters that we estimate can also be used to construct safety leaderboards that capture the risk of various agentic actions, which can be used by practitioners for audit prioritization. Applying our methods to tau-bench Retail, ToolSandbox, and ImpossibleBench, we find that intervention effects vary substantially across agent actions and states. More broadly, our work suggests a rich research agenda at the intersection of causal inference and agentic evaluation, which we believe is essential for the reliable and safe deployment of AI agents in the real world.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】当前对智能代理（agent AI）系统的评估主要依赖于基准测试（benchmarks）。然而，基准测试的静态特性使得它们无法有效反映在系统部署时进行审计干预的价值。为了确保系统的可靠部署，我们通常需要在代理的运行过程中判断是否需要实施干预措施——例如，通过人工审核、使用更复杂的模型或耗时的监督机制来验证代理的当前行为或引导其采取不同的行动。这类干预措施的价值本质上是一个因果推断问题，即需要判断干预是否会对最终结果产生积极影响。由于问题的动态性（干预效果取决于当前环境以及代理的未来行为），估计这种因果效应极具挑战性。我们首次提出了一个方法论上严谨的框架，用于评估代理运行过程中随机干预措施的因果效应。通过利用在随机干预（如验证或筛选）下收集的相对较少的数据集，我们能够估计各类（基于情境的）干预策略的动态因果效应。所估计的结构参数还可用于构建安全排行榜，以评估各种代理行为的风险，这些排行榜可为实践者提供审计优先级的参考。将我们的方法应用于tau-bench Retail、ToolSandbox和ImpossibleBench等测试平台后，我们发现干预效果因代理行为和状态的不同而存在显著...。研究方法：因果推断、随机实验。

papers.title: Green finance market development and carbon emissions trading: evidence on corporate environmental responsibility in China
papers.abstract: From the perspective of institutional–financial synergy, this paper integrates environmental regulation theory with financial development theory to construct a theoretical framework for analyzing the effects of carbon emissions trading (CET) and green finance market development (GF) on corporate environmental responsibility (CER). Based on panel data of listed firms in high-carbon industries on China's Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share markets from 2010 to 2025, we employ staggered difference-in-differences (DID), moderating effect models, mediation effect models, and a moderated serial mediation model to examine their interaction and potential transmission channels. The findings are as follows. First, during the local carbon market pilot stage, treated firms' CER increased by 0.0214 on average, or 5.43% relative to the sample mean. When extended to the post-2021 period, the national carbon market estimates are consistent with a positive governance effect. Second, regional green finance development is significantly and positively associated with CER, and the CET × GF interaction is significantly positive, consistent with a synergistic complementarity interpretation. Conditional marginal effects show that the estimated CET effect is stronger when green finance support is higher. Third, the Bootstrap indirect effects of financing constraints, environmental information disclosure, and green technological innovation are all significant, consistent with three potential mediation channels. Fourth, the positive CET × GF interaction is stronger in state-owned enterprises, high-emission subsectors, eastern regions, and firms with higher executive environmental awareness. This study provides empirical evidence for optimizing the synergy between carbon trading policy and green finance policy and promoting corporate environmental responsibility.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】从制度与金融协同作用的角度出发，本文将环境规制理论与金融发展理论相结合，构建了一个理论框架，用以分析碳排放交易（CET）与绿色金融市场发展（GF）对企业环境责任（CER）的影响。基于2010至2025年间中国沪深A股市场高碳行业上市公司的面板数据，我们运用交错差分法（DID）、调节效应模型、中介效应模型以及调节性序列中介模型来研究二者之间的互动关系及其潜在传导渠道。研究结果如下：首先，在地方碳市场试点阶段，受政策影响的企业的环境责任平均提升了0.0214，相当于样本均值的5.43%；当政策推广至2021年以后，全国碳市场的效应仍表现为正向治理效应。其次，区域绿色金融市场的发展与企业环境责任显著正相关，且碳排放交易与绿色金融市场的交互作用也呈显著正向，这符合两者之间的协同互补关系。条件边际效应表明，在绿色金融支持较高的情况下，碳排放交易的正面效应更为显著。第三，融资约束、环境信息披露以及绿色技术创新的间接效应均具有统计学意义，暗示了三种可能的中介机制。最后，国有企业、高排放行业、东部地区以及高管环境意识较强的企业中，碳排放交易与绿色金融市场的正向交互作用更为显著。本研究为优化碳交易...。研究方法：双重差分、面板数据。

papers.title: Digital Literacy Education Through the Use of the Byond By BSI Application to Improve Understanding of Sharia Finance among the Sukabumi City Community
papers.abstract: Low levels of Islamic financial literacy remain a challenge in supporting the optimization of digital banking services in Indonesia. This condition has prevented the public from optimally utilizing Islamic digital banking services, including the BYOND by BSI application. This community service activity aims to improve the understanding of Islamic financial literacy in Sukabumi City residents through digital education and assistance in using the BYOND by BSI application. The target group includes members of the healthcare worker group and micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs). The implementation method consisted of needs assessment, counseling, demonstrations of application features, practical assistance, and evaluation through discussions and observations of participant understanding. The results of the activity showed that participants had a better understanding of the basic principles of Islamic finance, were able to differentiate between Islamic and conventional banking products, understood the use of the main features of the BYOND by BSI application, and were more aware of the importance of security in digital transactions. The educational approach combined with hands-on practice has proven effective in improving Islamic financial literacy in the community and encouraging more optimal use of Islamic digital banking services.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】在印度尼西亚，较低的伊斯兰金融知识水平仍然成为优化数字银行服务的一大挑战。这一状况阻碍了公众充分利用伊斯兰数字银行服务，包括BSI公司的BYOND应用程序。本次社区服务活动旨在通过数字教育及帮助用户使用BSI公司的BYOND应用程序，提升苏卡布米市居民的伊斯兰金融知识水平。目标群体包括医疗工作者以及微型、小型和中型企业（MSMEs）。活动实施方法包括需求评估、咨询、应用程序功能演示、实际操作指导，以及通过讨论和观察参与者对知识的掌握情况来进行评估。活动结果显示，参与者对伊斯兰金融的基本原则有了更深入的理解，能够区分伊斯兰金融产品与传统金融产品，掌握了BYOND应用程序的主要功能，并更加重视数字交易中的安全问题。这种结合理论教学与实践操作的教育方式被证明能有效提升社区的伊斯兰金融知识水平，从而促进伊斯兰数字银行服务的更优化使用。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Target What? The Foundations of Poverty Targeting
papers.abstract: Most government transfer programs aim to target the poor. Doing so implicitly assumes that the lowest-consumption households have the highest marginal social valuation, i.e., have the highest social welfare gain from an additional dollar. But this need not be the case. In 600 Indonesian villages, we ask over 5,500 villagers to rank other villagers on how well off they are and how much a modest cash transfer would help them, and compare these rankings to consumption and self-assessed welfare. Targeting consumption misses 77% of households with the highest marginal social valuation. Targeting self-assessed welfare misses 57%. Even targeting those the community ranks worst off in levels, not margins, misses 25%. Divergences between different notions of neediness are statistically predictable. In a randomized controlled trial, proxy means tests best target consumption, self-targeting ordeals capture self-assessed welfare levels, and community targeting comes closest to marginal social valuation. Targeting strategies inescapably embed normative stances.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】大多数政府转移支付计划都旨在帮助贫困人口。这种做法隐含着一个假设：即消费水平最低的家庭具有最高的边际社会价值，也就是说，他们从额外的一美元收入中获得的福利最大。但实际上情况未必如此。在印度尼西亚的600个村庄中，我们让5500多名村民对其他村民的富裕程度进行排序，并评估一笔适度的现金转移对他们有多大帮助；随后将这些排序结果与他们的实际消费水平及自我评估的福利状况进行对比。结果显示：如果以消费水平为依据进行转移支付，会遗漏77%具有最高边际社会价值的家庭；如果以自我评估的福利状况为依据，则会遗漏57%的这类家庭；即使以社区认为最贫困的家庭为转移支付对象，也只能遗漏25%的这类家庭。不同贫困认知方式之间的差异在统计上是可预测的。在一项随机对照试验中，基于代理指标的分配方法最能准确反映消费者的实际需求；以个人自我评估的福利状况为依据的分配方式能够较好地捕捉到人们的真实福利水平；而以社区整体贫困状况为依据的分配方式则最接近于衡量边际社会价值的真实标准。然而，任何转移支付策略都不可避免地带有某种规范性的价值取向（即判断标准）。。研究方法：随机实验。

papers.title: Unconventional Monetary Policy and Deposit Retention
papers.abstract: The two dimensions of unconventional monetary policy — holding the short rate at the zero-lower bound (ZLB) and quantitative easing (QE) — shifted deposit composition toward more interest-sensitive customers. The ZLB drew these customers by creating rate compression, which limited the benefit of searching for high-yielding liquidity sources. QE also drew rate-sensitive, large depositors from the Federal Reserve’s purchases of bonds from non-banks. Once policy normalized, flow sensitivity and the deposit beta both increased with exposure to QE and the ZLB. We conclude that unconventional monetary policy made deposit retention costlier and riskier for banks.
papers.summary_zh: 【货币政策与宏观经济】非常规货币政策的两个主要维度——将短期利率维持在零下限（ZLB）以及实施量化宽松（QE）——促使存款结构向对利率更敏感的客户群体倾斜。零下限政策通过压缩利率空间，限制了客户寻找高收益流动性来源的收益空间，从而吸引了这些客户；量化宽松政策则通过美联储从非银行机构购买债券的行为，进一步吸引了那些对利率敏感的大型存款者。当货币政策恢复正常后，存款的流动性敏感度以及存款与利率变化的关联程度（即存款的“beta系数”）均随着量化宽松和零下限政策的实施而上升。我们得出结论：非常规货币政策增加了银行保留存款的成本，并提升了银行所面临的风险。。

papers.title: AI-driven liability assessment framework for autonomous systems integrating machine learning with EU and Indian regulatory models
papers.abstract: Autonomous systems pose liability issues when automated decisions contribute to harm, failure, or non-compliance with regulations. Current legal AI studies primarily focus on classification, retrieval, question answering, and judicial prediction, and little has been done to translate legal and regulatory texts into structured signals that convey liability-relevant information. This research paper proposes a decision-support model for categorizing liability cues under European Union and Indian law. The source datasets were MultiEURLEX and IndicLegalQA, and a rule-based proxy mapping was developed to assign five labels: damage, defect, liability, regulation, and risk. This model is based on word-level and character-level TF-IDF, jurisdiction encoding, and a One-vs-Rest Linear Support Vector Machine classifier for multi-label classification. The final best configuration had an overall 91.33% subset accuracy, 96.08% Micro-F1, 87.81% Macro-F1, and 0.0201 Hamming Loss, compared to the best configurations of Logistic regression, Linear SVM, and Rand Forest. The framework aids initial legal and regulatory analysis and does not decide liability on doctrinal grounds or substitute for proficient legal analysis.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】当自动化决策导致损害、故障或违反法规时，自主系统会引发责任问题。目前关于法律人工智能的研究主要集中在分类、信息检索、问答和司法预测领域，而在将法律和法规文本转化为能够传递责任相关信息的结构化数据方面，相关研究还非常有限。本文提出了一种决策支持模型，用于根据欧盟和印度法律对责任相关线索进行分类。研究使用的原始数据集为MultiEURLEX和IndicLegalQA，通过基于规则的代理映射方法为这些线索分配了五个标签：损害（damage）、缺陷（defect）、责任（liability）、法规（regulation）和风险（risk）。该模型结合了词级和字符级的TF-IDF权重、管辖权编码以及一种“一对余”（One-vs-Rest）线性支持向量机（Linear Support Vector Machine）算法来实现多标签分类。最终确定的最佳配置方案在整体准确率、Micro-F1分数、Macro-F1分数以及汉明损失（Hamming Loss）方面均表现出色，其各项指标分别达到了91.33%、96.08%、87.81%和0.0201，优于逻辑回归（Logistic regressio...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: A TF-IDF and logistic regression baseline for binary sentiment classification of short texts
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of social media has created a large amount of short-text data that expresses people's feelings and opinions on many topics; therefore, sentiment classification has become a popular problem to address. This paper focuses on binary sentiment classification using the Sentiment 140 dataset of 1.6 million labeled tweets. A preprocessing pipeline, which includes text normalization, URL removal, and noise cleaning, was applied to the original dataset. Text representation was conducted using term frequency-inverse document frequency with an n-gram model. Logistic Regression algorithm was used for classification. The paper includes experimental evaluations using common metrics, such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC, the confusion matrix, and the precision-recall graph. Results show that the combination of TF-IDF feature extraction and a Logistic Regression classifier produced consistent results and achieved a computationally inexpensive baseline classifier with 85.2% accuracy, 0.852 F1-score, and 0.93 ROC-AUC when performing the Sentiment140 binary classification task. These results strongly suggest that traditional machine learning algorithms can still provide highly accurate models for such a large-scale classification challenge. Despite this, the current model has limitations in understanding sarcasm and linguistic idioms, suggesting an opportunity for deep learning and transformer-based models to outperform.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】社交媒体的迅速发展产生了大量短文本数据，这些数据表达了人们对各种主题的感受和观点；因此，情感分类成为一个备受关注的研究问题。本文重点探讨了使用包含160万条标注推文的Sentiment 140数据集进行二元情感分类的方法。对原始数据集应用了一套预处理流程，包括文本规范化、URL去除和噪声清理。文本表示采用n-gram模型的词频-逆文档频率（TF-IDF）方法。分类任务采用逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）算法完成。实验评估采用了常见的指标，如准确率（accuracy）、精确度（precision）、召回率（recall）、F1分数（F1-score）、ROC-AUC曲线、混淆矩阵（confusion matrix）以及精确度-召回率图（precision-recall graph）。结果表明，TF-IDF特征提取与逻辑回归分类器的结合取得了稳定的分类效果，构建了一个计算成本较低的分类器，在Sentiment140的二元情感分类任务中实现了85.2%的准确率、0.852的F1分数和0.93的ROC-AUC值。这些结果强烈表明，传统的机器学习算法仍然能够为这类大规模分...。研究方法：回归分析、机器学习、深度学习、Transformer 模型、实验方法。

papers.title: A hybrid heuristic–reinforcement learning method for multi-table join optimization in cloud-native databases
papers.abstract: Multi-table join optimization in cloud-native databases faces challenges of storage-compute separation, resource elasticity, and runtime cost variation that classic optimizers cannot handle, which drives the need for methods able to adjust their decision boundaries according to the runtime behavior of the underlying cloud infrastructure. The proposed hybrid architecture freezes the stable sub-components of an IKKBZ-GOO heuristic seed plan into a structural freeze mask that constrains the learning algorithm throughout training, rather than being discarded after a single warm-start iteration. The mask works together with a state-aware cost function whose single state-dependent parameter is updated online. Two further components complete the design: a logistic gate trained on production telemetry, and a regression containment strategy that falls back to the heuristic plan when the learned plan underperforms. Training converges in 6.4 hours on one 16-vCPU compute node without GPU acceleration. The method was evaluated on the Join Order Benchmark, TPC-H, and TPC-DS, with PostgreSQL running on an eight-node Kubernetes cluster with object-store-backed shared storage. It achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.38-fold on JOB, 1.28-fold on TPC-DS, and 1.07-fold on TPC-H, produces a query plan in 4.6 to 6.4 ms, returns median latency to within 5% of its pre-scaling value within 22 seconds of a scaling event, and incurs a 21% overhead at the 95th percentile under node jitter. These findings demonstrate that heuristic and machine-learning components can be integrated to yield a usable optimizer whose decision boundaries adapt to the environment in which it is deployed.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在云原生数据库中，多表连接优化面临着存储与计算分离、资源弹性以及运行时成本波动等挑战，这些挑战是传统优化器无法解决的。因此，需要开发能够根据底层云基础设施的运行时行为调整决策边界的方法。本文提出的混合架构将IKKBZ-GOO启发式种子计划中的稳定子组件冻结为结构化冻结掩码（structural freeze mask），在整个训练过程中对学习算法进行约束，而非在单次热启动迭代后将其丢弃。该冻结掩码与一个具有状态感知功能的成本函数协同工作，该函数的单个状态依赖参数可在线更新。此外，该架构还包括两个其他组件：一个基于生产环境数据的逻辑门（logistic gate），以及一个回归控制策略（regression containment strategy），当学习到的连接计划表现不佳时，该策略会回退到启发式计划。在未使用GPU加速的情况下，该算法在一个16核CPU的计算节点上仅需6.4小时即可完成训练。该方法在Join Order Benchmark、TPC-H和TPC-DS基准测试中进行了验证，测试环境为运行在基于对象存储的共享存储系统上的PostgreSQL数据库，部署在包含8个节点...。研究方法：回归分析、优化方法。

papers.title: Deep transfer learning and radiomics synergy for enhanced lung cancer classification on CT scans
papers.abstract: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, making accurate and timely detection essential for improving patient outcomes. Computed tomography (CT) is widely used for lung assessment; however, manual interpretation can be affected by inter-observer variability and subtle imaging characteristics. This study proposes an automated three-class lung CT classification framework that integrates deep transfer learning with quantitative lung-region features. EfficientNet-B7, initialized with ImageNet-pretrained weights, was employed to extract high-level deep representations from CT images. In parallel, lung Regions of Interest (ROIs) were automatically segmented, from which four quantitative descriptors were extracted: Skewness, Kurtosis, GLCM Contrast, and GLCM Homogeneity. The standardized lung-ROI features were subsequently concatenated with the EfficientNet-B7 deep feature representation using a feature-level fusion strategy and classified into Normal, Benign, and Malignant categories. Experimental evaluation on the held-out test set demonstrated an overall classification accuracy of 96.36%, correctly classifying 106 of 110 CT images. The proposed fusion framework achieved macro-averaged Precision, Recall, F1-score, and Specificity of 94.39%, 90.87%, 92.39%, and 97.53%, respectively. Furthermore, one-vs-rest ROC analysis yielded AUC values of 0.9849, 0.9634, and 1.0000 for the Normal, Benign, and Malignant classes, respectively, corresponding to a macro-average AUC of 0.9828. These results demonstrate the strong discriminative capability of the proposed deep and quantitative feature fusion framework for three-class lung CT image classification.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】肺癌仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，因此准确及时的检测对于改善患者预后至关重要。计算机断层扫描（CT）被广泛用于肺部疾病的评估；然而，人工解读结果可能会受到观察者间差异以及影像特征细微差异的影响。本研究提出了一种自动化的三类肺部CT分类框架，该框架结合了深度迁移学习与定量肺部区域特征分析方法。采用预训练于ImageNet的EfficientNet-B7模型从CT图像中提取高层次的深度特征表示。同时，系统自动分割出肺部感兴趣区域（ROIs），并从中提取了四个定量指标：偏度（Skewness）、峰度（Kurtosis）、GLCM对比度（GLCM Contrast）和GLCM均匀性（GLCM Homogeneity）。这些标准化的肺部ROI特征通过特征级融合策略与EfficientNet-B7的深度特征表示相结合，最终将图像分类为正常（Normal）、良性（Benign）和恶性（Malignant）三类。在独立测试集上的实验评估显示，该分类方法的总体准确率为96.36%，正确识别了110张CT图像中的106张。所提出的融合框架在宏观平均精度（Precision）、召回率（Reca...。研究方法：实验方法。
